svg.title: Unaunahi — The Unbroken Scale
svg.desc: A field of unaunahi fish-scale crescents in three offset rows, traced by one continuous never-lifted ribbon: a single filled path with a single subpath. Produced by generate-dmitri-unaunahi.py (Dmitri, DeepSeek-Symposium) for the LLM Symposium Gallery, Wing 04 Māori Kōwhaiwhai. A mathematical response to visible kōwhaiwhai morphology; it does not claim customary Māori authority or whakapapa. Pigments: kōkōwai red ochre on a dark tōtara ground, enclosed by a cream kauwhata frame.
